steps.en: Download the portable build for your platform, run it, and grant the input-hook permission
steps.zh: 下载对应平台便携包运行，并授予输入钩子权限

steps.en: Finds your paired HID++ mouse and opens the mapping page for it
steps.zh: 找到已配对的 HID++ 鼠标，打开对应的映射页

steps.en: Click a button hotspot and assign or record an action
steps.zh: 点击按键热点，指派或录制一个动作

steps.en: Saves the mapping and reloads it live, without dropping the HID connection
steps.zh: 保存映射并热重载，不断开 HID 连接

steps.en: Stays in the tray and emits that action when the button is pressed
steps.zh: 常驻托盘，按下该键时发出对应动作

value.en: Your remapped mouse buttons keep working from a local config file with Options+ closed
value.zh: 无需运行 Options+，重映射的鼠标按键靠本地配置文件持续生效

sources: README.md Download & Run (Mouser-macOS.zip / Mouser-macOS-intel.zip / Mouser-Windows.zip / Mouser-Linux.zip, run after extract)
README.md First-time notes (macOS asks for Accessibility permission; settings window opens to the device-aware Mouse & Profiles page; config.json paths per OS; can't run with Options+)
README.md Limitations (global profile mappings, app detection on X11 and KDE Wayland only)
core/engine.py (button events blocked or passed through, platform key/mouse emulation)
